_comment: Shape: { "<artifact>": { "<key>": "<reason>" } }, artifact = story | demo | e2e | class-input | data-slot.
story / demo / e2e are keyed by registry component name; class-input / data-slot are keyed by the
component file's path relative to packages/components/ui (e.g. "dialog/sub/dialog-title.component.ts").
THIS FILE IS DELIBERATELY EMPTY. It was seeded in July 2026 with 137 grandfathered
entries (6 missing stories, 51 missing/orphan demo routes, 80 components with no e2e
coverage) so the gate could be adopted without failing on day one. That backlog has
since been paid off in full, so every exemption went stale and was removed.
Empty is the target state. An entry here is debt: it silences a real gap. Add one only
with a specific, honest reason (never a blanket 'grandfathered'), and remove it as soon
as the artifact exists — the gate reports stale entries and fails until they are gone.
